description.value:
Rank 1 Weapon Technique

  • Ki Cost: 6 Ki
  • Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Ranged Weapon that you are proficient with.
  • Casting Time: 1 Action
  • Range: Weapon's Range
  • Duration: Instantaneous
  • Chargeable: Yes

You focus your shot with a small portion of your ki, firing it once they are within range with much more force. Roll a Combo Attack Roll dealing your Weapon Damage Die + 1d4 Damage. Creatures who are hit with this attack are knocked back 15 feet.

system.requirements: 1 *Simple or Martial Ranged Weapon* that you are proficient with.
